ns2:section.sectionText: This course explores the public address of Barack Obama. In the class, we'll seek to trace the basic contours of his body of rhetoric and, in a larger sense, of his presidency and times. The course will focus on primary and secondary sources, with a variety of concepts being brought to bear on specific texts during each week of the class. We seek to understand the lineaments of his persuasion--the basic elements that make up his appeal to the American public.
